en: Vintage monochrome postcard showing a quiet street scene in a small historic town. A large tree dominates the center, standing on a raised terrace with a retaining wall and stairs or ramp leading up. Behind it are steep‑roofed, multi‑story masonry buildings with small gabled dormers, characteristic of Central European architecture. To the left is a building bearing painted German signage, and a person with a cart is visible on the street. The card has printed red captions on the front: the town name at the top and publisher information and number at the bottom.
